baseitem.name: Alchemist's Supplies
additionalEntries: Alchemist's supplies enable a character to produce useful concoctions, such as acid or alchemist's fire.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Alchemist's supplies include two glass beakers, a metal frame to hold a beaker in place over an open flame, a glass stirring rod, a small mortar and pestle, and a pouch of common alchemical ingredients, including salt, powdered iron, and purified water.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Proficiency with alchemist's supplies allows you to unlock more information on {@skill Arcana} checks involving potions and similar materials.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you inspect an area for clues, proficiency with alchemist's supplies grants additional insight into any chemicals or other substances that might have been used in the area.

additionalEntries.name: Alchemical Crafting
entries: You can use this tool proficiency to create alchemical items. A character can spend money to collect raw materials, which weigh 1 pound for every 50 gp spent. The DM can allow a character to make a check using the indicated skill with advantage. As part of a long rest, you can use alchemist's supplies to make one dose of {@item acid (vial)|phb|acid}, {@item alchemist's fire (flask)|phb|alchemist's fire}, {@item antitoxin (vial)|phb|antitoxin}, {@item oil (flask)|phb|oil}, {@item perfume (vial)|phb|perfume}, or {@item soap|phb}. Subtract half the value of the created item from the total gp worth of raw materials you are carrying.

additionalEntries.caption: Alchemist's Supplies
rows: Create a puff of thick smoke

items.name: Ability:
entries: 智力

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 辨識一種物質（{@dc 15}），或生火（{@dc 15}）

items.name: Craft:

baseitem.name: Arrow
entries: 箭需搭配具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。每次以該武器攻擊時，你會消耗一件彈藥。從箭筒、箭匣或其他容器中取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束時，你可以花費一分鐘搜索戰場，回收一半已消耗的彈藥。
箭通常存放在{@item Quiver|XPHB|箭袋}中（需另購）。

baseitem.name: Birdpipes
entries: Pan pipes or satyr pipes, also known as the shalm, these are sacred to {@deity Lliira|Faerûnian|scag} and popular with wood elf and wild elf bards.

baseitem.name: Bolt
entries: 弩矢需搭配具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。每次以該武器攻擊時，你會消耗一件彈藥。從箭筒、箭匣或其他容器中取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束時，你可以花費一分鐘搜索戰場，回收一半已消耗的彈藥。

baseitem.name: Bolts (20)
entries: 弩矢需搭配具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。每次以該武器攻擊時，你會消耗一件彈藥。從箭筒、箭匣或其他容器中取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束時，你可以花費一分鐘搜索戰場，回收一半已消耗的彈藥。
弩矢通常存放在{@item Crossbow Bolt Case|XPHB|弩矢匣}中（需另購）。

baseitem.name: Breastplate
entries: 這套護甲是由一塊墊著柔軟皮革的合身鐵製胸板所構成。雖然它相對來說保護不了手和腳，但這套護甲能在為穿載者的重要器官提供良好保護的同時，而不太會妨礙穿載者的行動。

baseitem.name: Brewer's Supplies
additionalEntries: Brewing is the art of producing beer. Not only does beer serve as an alcoholic beverage, but the process of brewing purifies water. Crafting beer takes weeks of fermentation, but only a few hours of work.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Brewer's supplies include a large glass jug, a quantity of hops, a siphon, and several feet of tubing.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: Proficiency with brewer's supplies gives you additional insight on Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks concerning events that involve alcohol as a significant element.

additionalEntries.name: Medicine
entries: This tool proficiency grants additional insight when you treat anyone suffering from alcohol poisoning or when you can use alcohol to dull pain.

additionalEntries.name: Persuasion
entries: A stiff drink can help soften the hardest heart. Your proficiency with brewer's supplies can help you ply someone with drink, giving them just enough alcohol to mellow their mood.

additionalEntries.name: Potable Water
entries: Your knowledge of brewing enables you to purify water that would otherwise be undrinkable. As part of a long rest, you can purify up to 6 gallons of water, or 1 gallon as part of a short rest.

additionalEntries.caption: Brewer's Supplies
rows: Detect poison or impurities in a drink

baseitem.name: Calligrapher's Supplies
additionalEntries: Calligraphy treats writing as a delicate, beautiful art. Calligraphers produce text that is pleasing to the eye, using a style that is difficult to forge. Their supplies also give them some ability to examine scripts and determine if they are legitimate, since a calligrapher's training involves long hours of studying writing and attempting to replicate its style and design.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Calligrapher's supplies include ink, a dozen sheets of parchment, and three quills.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Although calligraphy is of little help in deciphering the content of magical writings, proficiency with these supplies can aid in identifying who wrote a script of a magical nature.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: This tool proficiency can augment the benefit of successful checks made to analyze or investigate ancient writings, scrolls, or other texts, including runes etched in stone or messages in frescoes or other displays.

additionalEntries.name: Decipher Treasure Map
entries: This tool proficiency grants you expertise in examining maps. You can make an Intelligence check to determine a map's age, whether a map includes any hidden messages, or similar facts.

items.name: Ability:
entries: 敏捷

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 以華麗的筆法書寫難以偽造的文字（{@dc 15}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Ink|XPHB}, {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG}

baseitem.name: Carpenter's Tools
additionalEntries: Skill at carpentry enables a character to construct wooden structures. A carpenter can build a house, a shack, a wooden cabinet, or similar items.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Carpenter's tools include a saw, a hammer, nails, a hatchet, a square, a ruler, an adze, a plane, and a chisel.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: This tool proficiency aids you in identifying the use and the origin of wooden buildings and other large wooden objects.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: You gain additional insight when inspecting areas within wooden structures, because you know tricks of construction that can conceal areas from discovery.

additionalEntries.name: Perception
entries: You can spot irregularities in wooden walls or floors, making it easier to find trap doors and secret passages.

additionalEntries.name: Stealth
entries: You can quickly assess the weak spots in a wooden floor, making it easier to avoid the places that creak and groan when they're stepped on.

additionalEntries.name: Fortify
entries: With 1 minute of work and raw materials, you can make a door or window harder to force open. Increase the DC needed to open it by 5.

additionalEntries.name: Temporary Shelter
entries: As part of a long rest, you can construct a lean-to or a similar shelter to keep your group dry and in the shade for the duration of the rest. Because it was fashioned quickly from whatever wood was available, the shelter collapses {@dice 1d3} days after being assembled.

additionalEntries.caption: Carpenter's Tools
rows: Find a weak point in a wooden wall

items.name: Ability:
entries: 力量

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 封死或撬開一扇門或一個容器（{@dc 20}）

items.name: Craft:

baseitem.name: Cartographer's Tools
additionalEntries: Using cartographer's tools, you can create accurate maps to make travel easier for yourself and those who come after you. These maps can range from large-scale depictions of mountain ranges to diagrams that show the layout of a dungeon level.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Cartographer's tools consist of a quill, ink, parchment, a pair of compasses, calipers, and a ruler.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History, Religion
entries: You can use your knowledge of maps and locations to unearth more detailed information when you use these skills. For instance, you might spot hidden messages in a map, identify when the map was made to determine if geographical features have changed since then, and so forth.

additionalEntries.name: Nature
entries: Your familiarity with physical geography makes it easier for you to answer questions or solve issues relating to the terrain around you.

additionalEntries.name: Survival
entries: Your understanding of geography makes it easier to find paths to civilization, to predict areas where villages or towns might be found, and to avoid becoming lost. You have studied so many maps that common patterns, such as how trade routes evolve and where settlements arise in relation to geographic locations, are familiar to you.

additionalEntries.name: Craft a Map
entries: While traveling, you can draw a map as you go in addition to engaging in other activity.

additionalEntries.caption: Cartographer's Tools
rows: Determine a map's age and origin
Estimate direction and distance to a landmark
Discern that a map is fake
Fill in a missing part of a map

items.name: Utilize:

items.name: Craft:

baseitem.name: Chain Mail
entries: 由交織的鐵環製成，鎖子甲還包括了一層襯墊在鎖甲下方的布料以避免擦傷和分散衝擊力。整套護甲還包含了一雙鐵手套。

baseitem.name: Chain Shirt
entries: 由交織的鐵環製成，鏈甲衫被穿在層層布料或皮革之間。這套護甲為穿戴者的上半身提供了適當的保護，且透過外層衣物蒙住鐵環彼此摩擦所發出的聲音。

baseitem.name: Cobbler's Tools
additionalEntries: Although the cobbler's trade might seem too humble for an adventurer, a good pair of boots will see a character across rugged wilderness and through deadly dungeons.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Cobbler's tools consist of a hammer, an awl, a knife, a shoe stand, a cutter, spare leather, and thread.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your knowledge of shoes aids you in identifying the magical properties of enchanted boots or the history of such items.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: Footwear holds a surprising number of secrets. You can learn where someone has recently visited by examining the wear and the dirt that has accumulated on their shoes. Your experience in repairing shoes makes it easier for you to identify where damage might come from.

additionalEntries.name: Maintain Shoes
entries: As part of a long rest, you can repair your companions' shoes. For the next 24 hours, up to six creatures of your choice who wear shoes you worked on can travel up to 10 hours a day without making saving throws to avoid {@condition exhaustion}.

additionalEntries.name: Craft Hidden Compartment
entries: With 8 hours of work, you can add a hidden compartment to a pair of shoes. The compartment can hold an object up to 3 inches long and 1 inch wide and deep. You make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency to determine the Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check DC needed to find the compartment.

additionalEntries.caption: Cobbler's Tools
rows: Determine a shoe's age and origin
Find a hidden compartment in a boot heel

items.name: Craft:

baseitem.name: Cook's Utensils
additionalEntries: Adventuring is a hard life. With a cook along on the journey, your meals will be much better than the typical mix of hardtack and dried fruit.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Cook's utensils include a metal pot, knives, forks, a stirring spoon, and a ladle.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: Your knowledge of cooking techniques allows you to assess the social patterns involved in a culture's eating habits.

additionalEntries.name: Medicine
entries: When administering treatment, you can transform medicine that is bitter or sour into a pleasing concoction.

additionalEntries.name: Survival
entries: When foraging for food, you can make do with ingredients you scavenge that others would be unable to transform into nourishing meals.

additionalEntries.name: Prepare Meals
entries: As part of a short rest, you can prepare a tasty meal that helps your companions regain their strength. You and up to five creatures of your choice regain 1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent during a short rest, provided you have access to your cook's utensils and sufficient food.

additionalEntries.caption: Cook's Utensils
rows: Spot poison or impurities in food

items.name: Craft:

baseitem.name: Glassblower's Tools
additionalEntries: Someone who is proficient with glassblower's tools has not only the ability to shape glass, but also specialized knowledge of the methods used to produce glass objects.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: The tools include a blowpipe, a small marver, blocks, and tweezers. You need a source of heat to work glass.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your knowledge of glassmaking techniques aids you when you examine glass objects, such as potion bottles or glass items found in a treasure hoard. For instance, you can study how a glass potion bottle has been changed by its contents to help determine a potion's effects. (A potion might leave behind a residue, deform the glass, or stain it.)

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you study an area, your knowledge can aid you if the clues include broken glass or glass objects.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Weakness
entries: With 1 minute of study, you can identify the weak points in a glass object. Any damage dealt to the object by striking a weak spot is doubled.

additionalEntries.caption: Glassblower's Tools
rows: Determine what a glass object once held

items.name: Utilize:

baseitem.name: Glaur
entries: Short, curved horns like a cornucopia. Played with valves, glaur sound like trumpets, while those without valves, known as gloon, have a more mournful sound.

baseitem.name: Half Plate Armor
entries: 半身板甲由一片片特別形狀的鐵板所構成，覆蓋穿載者大部分的上半身。它對腿部提供的保護僅止於以皮帶固定的護脛。

baseitem.name: Hand Drum
entries: A double-headed skin drum fitted with handles along its side.

baseitem.name: Hide Armor
entries: 這套粗糙的護甲由厚毛和生皮製成。它常見於蠻人部族，邪惡類人，和其他因欠缺適當的工具和材料而無法製造較好防具的族群。

baseitem.name: Hooked Shortspear
entries: On a hit with this weapon, the wielder can forgo dealing damage and attempt to trip the target, in which case the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC is 8 + the wielder's Strength modifier + the wielder's proficiency bonus.

baseitem.name: Hoopak
entries: A hoopak is a sturdy stick with a sling at one end and a pointed tip at the other.

entries.name: Special
entries: When you make a melee attack with this weapon, you ignore its ammunition property. You can use the hoopak as a martial ranged weapon. If you do, it uses the ammunition property, uses sling bullets, and deals {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

baseitem.name: Jeweler's Tools
additionalEntries: Training with jeweler's tools includes the basic techniques needed to beautify gems. It also gives you expertise in identifying precious stones.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Jeweler's tools consist of a small saw and hammer, files, pliers, and tweezers.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Proficiency with jeweler's tools grants you knowledge about the reputed mystical uses of gems. This insight proves handy when you make {@skill Arcana} checks related to gems or gem-encrusted items.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you inspect jeweled objects, your proficiency with jeweler's tools aids you in picking out clues they might hold.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Gems
entries: You can identify gems and determine their value at a glance.

entries.name: Special
entries: 你在使用騎槍攻擊距離你5呎內的目標時承受劣勢。並且當你非騎乘時，你必須使用雙手以持握騎槍。

baseitem.name: Lance
entries: 未騎乘時，騎槍需要雙手才能揮舞。

baseitem.name: Leather Armor
entries: 這套護甲的護胸和肩甲是由浸泡過滾油而硬化的皮革製成。護甲的其他部分則是用較柔軟且具彈性的材料製作。

baseitem.name: Leatherworker's Tools
additionalEntries: Knowledge of leatherworking extends to lore concerning animal hides and their properties. It also confers knowledge of leather armor and similar goods.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Leatherworker's tools include a knife, a small mallet, an edger, a hole punch, thread, and leather scraps.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Your expertise in working with leather grants you added insight when you inspect magic items crafted from leather, such as boots and some cloaks.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: You gain added insight when studying leather items or clues related to them, as you draw on your knowledge of leather to pick out details that others would overlook.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Hides
entries: When looking at a hide or a leather item, you can determine the source of the leather and any special techniques used to treat it. For example, you can spot the difference between leather crafted using dwarven methods and leather crafted using halfling methods.

items.name: Ability:
entries: 敏捷

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 在皮革物品上添加圖樣（{@dc 10}）

baseitem.name: Light Repeating Crossbow
entries: This crossbow is fitted with a cartridge that can hold up to six crossbow bolts. It automatically reloads after firing until the cartridge runs out of ammunition. Reloading the cartridge takes an action.

additionalEntries: Mason's tools allow you to craft stone structures, including walls and buildings crafted from brick.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Mason's tools consist of a trowel, a hammer, a chisel, brushes, and a square.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: Your expertise aids you in identifying a stone building's date of construction and purpose, along with insight into who might have built it.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: You gain additional insight when inspecting areas within stone structures.

additionalEntries.name: Perception
entries: You can spot irregularities in stone walls or floors, making it easier to find trap doors and secret passages.

additionalEntries.name: Demolition
entries: Your knowledge of masonry allows you to spot weak points in brick walls. You deal double damage to such structures with your weapon attacks.

baseitem.name: Needle
entries: 吹箭筒的吹針需搭配具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。每次以該武器攻擊時，你會消耗一件彈藥。從箭筒、箭匣或其他容器中取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束時，你可以花費一分鐘搜索戰場，回收一半已消耗的彈藥。
吹針通常存放在{@item Pouch|XPHB|囊袋}中（需另購）。

吹針通常存放在{@item Pouch|XPHB|囊袋}中（需另購）。

entries.name: Special
entries: 體型為大型或更小的生物在被捕網命中時將被{@condition Restrained||束縛}，直到他被釋放。捕網對於不定型生物、或體型為巨型或以上的生物沒有任何效果。生物可以使用他的動作以進行一次DC10的力量檢定，成功則釋放他自己或位於他觸及距離內的另一個生物。對捕網（AC10）造成5點劈砍傷害同樣可以釋放該生物而不會傷害到他。當你使用動作、附贈動作、或反應以捕網攻擊時，無論你原本可以進行幾次攻擊，你都只能進行一次攻擊。

baseitem.name: Padded Armor
entries: 綿甲是由一層層縫起的布料和棉絮所製成。

baseitem.name: Painter's Supplies
additionalEntries: Proficiency with painter's supplies represents your ability to paint and draw. You also acquire an understanding of art history, which can aid you in examining works of art.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Painter's supplies include an easel, canvas, paints, brushes, charcoal sticks, and a palette.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History, Religion
entries: Your expertise aids you in uncovering lore of any sort that is attached to a work of art, such as the magical properties of a painting or the origins of a strange mural found in a dungeon.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation, Perception
entries: When you inspect a painting or a similar work of visual art, your knowledge of the practices behind creating it can grant you additional insight.

additionalEntries.name: Painting and Drawing
entries: As part of a short or long rest, you can produce a simple work of art. Although your work might lack precision, you can capture an image or a scene, or make a quick copy of a piece of art you saw.

additionalEntries.caption: Painter's Supplies
rows: Create a painting with a hidden message

items.name: Ability:
entries: 感知

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 畫出你看過之事物的可辨識圖像（{@dc 10}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Druidic Focus|XPHB}, {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB}

items.name: Ability:
entries: 魅力

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 演奏一首熟悉的曲子（{@dc 10}），或即興創作一首歌（{@dc 15}）

baseitem.name: Plate Armor
entries: 全身板甲由特定形狀、互相扣鎖的鐵板所構成以覆蓋全身。整套全身板甲還包括一雙鐵手套、重皮靴、附面甲的頭盔、和護甲底下墊著的厚厚襯墊。皮帶和索具將整套護甲的重量平均分佈到全身。

baseitem.name: Potter's Tools
additionalEntries: Potter's tools are used to create a variety of ceramic objects, most typically pots and similar vessels.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Potter's tools include potter's needles, ribs, scrapers, a knife, and calipers.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: Your expertise aids you in identifying ceramic objects, including when they were created and their likely place or culture of origin.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation, Perception
entries: You gain additional insight when inspecting ceramics, uncovering clues others would overlook by spotting minor irregularities.

additionalEntries.name: Reconstruction
entries: By examining pottery shards, you can determine an object's original, intact form and its likely purpose.

additionalEntries.caption: Potter's Tools
rows: Determine what a vessel once held
Find a weak point in a ceramic object

items.name: Ability:
entries: 智力

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 辨別一件陶瓷物品在過去 24 小時內盛裝過什麼（{@dc 15}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Jug|XPHB}, {@item Lamp|XPHB}

baseitem.name: Ring Mail
entries: 這套護甲是縫上了重鐵環的皮甲。護甲上的鐵環能有效幫助抵擋劍和斧的斬擊。環甲略遜於鎖子甲，且因此通常被無法負擔更好護甲的人們穿戴。

baseitem.name: Scale Mail
entries: 這套護甲由皮革製的上衣及綁腿（或許還帶有一件短裙）構成，皮革表面覆蓋著彼此交疊的金屬片，就像是魚鱗一樣。整套護甲還包含了一雙鐵手套。

baseitem.name: Shawm
entries: A double-reed instrument similar to an oboe or a bassoon, popular with gnomes, who have developed some bellows-powered versions.

items.name: Ability:
entries: 魅力

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 演奏一首熟悉的曲子（{@dc 10}），或即興創作一首歌（{@dc 15}）

baseitem.name: Shield
entries: 盾牌由木頭或金屬打造，且可以用一隻手攜帶。持握一面盾牌會增加你的護甲等級2點。你同時只能受益於一面盾牌的效果。

baseitem.name: Sling Bullet
entries: 投石索彈丸需搭配具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。每次以該武器攻擊時，你會消耗一件彈藥。從箭筒、箭匣或其他容器中取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束時，你可以花費一分鐘搜索戰場，回收一半已消耗的彈藥。
投石索彈丸通常存放在{@item Pouch|XPHB|囊袋}中（需另購）。

baseitem.name: Sling Bullets (20)
entries: 投石索彈丸需搭配具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。每次以該武器攻擊時，你會消耗一件彈藥。從箭筒、箭匣或其他容器中取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束時，你可以花費一分鐘搜索戰場，回收一半已消耗的彈藥。
投石索彈丸通常存放在{@item Pouch|XPHB|囊袋}中（需另購）。

baseitem.name: Smith's Tools
additionalEntries: Smith's tools allow you to work metal, heating it to alter its shape, repair damage, or work raw ingots into useful items.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Smith's tools include hammers, tongs, charcoal, rags, and a whetstone.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana and History
entries: Your expertise lends you additional insight when examining metal objects, such as weapons.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: You can spot clues and make deductions that others might overlook when an investigation involves armor, weapons, or other metalwork.

additionalEntries.name: Repair
entries: With access to your tools and an open flame hot enough to make metal pliable, you can restore 10 hit points to a damaged metal object for each hour of work.

items.name: Ability:
entries: 力量

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 撬開一扇門或一個容器（{@dc 20}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: 任何近戰武器（{@item Club|XPHB|棍棒}、{@item Greatclub|XPHB|巨棍}、{@item Quarterstaff|XPHB|長棍}與{@item Whip|XPHB|鞭}除外）、中甲（{@item Hide Armor|XPHB|生皮甲}除外）、重甲、{@item Ball Bearings|XPHB|滾珠}、{@item Bucket|XPHB|水桶}、{@item Caltrops|XPHB|鐵蒺藜}、{@item Chain|XPHB|鎖鏈}、{@item Crowbar|XPHB|撬棍}、{@item Firearm Bullets (10)|XPHB|火器子彈}、{@item Grappling Hook|XPHB|爪鉤}、{@item Iron Pot|XPHB|鐵鍋}、{@item Iron Spikes|XPHB|鐵釘（10 根）}、{@item Sling Bullets (20)|XPHB|投石索彈丸}

baseitem.name: Songhorn
entries: A recorder, a simple type of flute, usually carved from wood.

baseitem.name: Spiked Armor
entries: 釘刺甲是由矮人製造的一種稀有中甲。它是由被通常以金屬打造的尖刺覆蓋的皮製大衣所構成。

baseitem.name: Splint Armor
entries: 這套護甲是由狹長的直鐵條鉚接於穿在墊衣外層的皮襯上所製成。並以靈活的鎖子甲保護著關節。

baseitem.name: Studded Leather Armor
entries: 由強韌而柔軟的皮革製成，鑲釘皮甲被以緊密的鉚釘或尖刺進一步強化。

baseitem.name: Tantan
entries: A tambourine, a popular instrument with halflings and humans south of the Dalelands.

baseitem.name: Thelarr
entries: Also known as a whistlecane, a simple and easy-to-make wind instrument cut from a reed. They are so simple, in fact, that skilled bards frequently make and give them away to children—to the parents' delight or regret.

baseitem.name: Tinker's Tools
additionalEntries: A set of tinker's tools is designed to enable you to repair many mundane objects. Though you can't manufacture much with tinker's tools, you can mend torn clothes, sharpen a worn sword, and patch a tattered suit of chain mail.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Tinker's tools include a variety of hand tools, thread, needles, a whetstone, scraps of cloth and leather, and a small pot of glue.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: You can determine the age and origin of objects, even if you have only a few pieces remaining from the original.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you inspect a damaged object, you gain knowledge of how it was damaged and how long ago.

additionalEntries.name: Repair
entries: You can restore 10 hit points to a damaged object for each hour of work. For any object, you need access to the raw materials required to repair it. For metal objects, you need access to an open flame hot enough to make the metal pliable.

additionalEntries.caption: Tinker's Tools
rows: Repair an item in half the time
Improvise a temporary item using scraps

items.name: Ability:
entries: 敏捷

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 用廢料組裝一件微型物品，該物品會在 1 分鐘後散架（{@dc 20}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Musket|XPHB}, {@item Pistol|XPHB}, {@item Bell|XPHB}, {@item Bullseye Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Flask|XPHB}, {@item Hooded Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Hunting Trap|XPHB}, {@item Lock|XPHB}, {@item Manacles|XPHB}, {@item Mirror|XPHB}, {@item Shovel|XPHB}, {@item Signal Whistle|XPHB}, {@item Tinderbox|XPHB}

baseitem.name: Tocken
entries: A hanging set of carved oval bells, usually played with a pair of light wooden hammers (or open handed). They are most common in underground cultures, where the resonant tones can carry.

items.name: Ability:
entries: 魅力

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 演奏一首熟悉的曲子（{@dc 10}），或即興創作一首歌（{@dc 15}）

baseitem.name: Wargong
entries: A metal gong, traditionally made from a shield, particularly the shield of an enemy. Both goblins and dwarves make and play wargongs, their sound echoing through tunnels in the Underdark.

baseitem.name: Weaver's Tools
additionalEntries: Weaver's tools allow you to create cloth and tailor it into articles of clothing.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Weaver's tools include thread, needles, and scraps of cloth. You know how to work a loom, but such equipment is too large to transport.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your expertise lends you additional insight when examining cloth objects, including cloaks and robes.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: Using your knowledge of the process of creating cloth objects, you can spot clues and make deductions that others would overlook when you examine tapestries, upholstery, clothing, and other woven items.

additionalEntries.name: Repair
entries: As part of a short rest, you can repair a single damaged cloth object.

additionalEntries.name: Craft Clothing
entries: Assuming you have access to sufficient cloth and thread, you can create an outfit for a creature as part of a long rest.

additionalEntries.caption: Weaver's Tools
rows: Mend a hole in a piece of cloth

items.name: Ability:
entries: 敏捷

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 縫補衣物的破洞（{@dc 10}），或縫製一個微型圖樣（{@dc 10}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Padded Armor|XPHB}, {@item Basket|XPHB}, {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, {@item Blanket|XPHB}, {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB}, {@item Net|XPHB}, {@item Robe|XPHB}, {@item Rope|XPHB}, {@item Sack|XPHB}, {@item String|XPHB}, {@item Tent|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}

baseitem.name: Woodcarver's Tools
additionalEntries: Woodcarver's tools allow you to craft intricate objects from wood, such as wooden tokens or arrows.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Woodcarver's tools consist of a knife, a gouge, and a small saw.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your expertise lends you additional insight when you examine wooden objects, such as figurines or arrows.

additionalEntries.name: Nature
entries: Your knowledge of wooden objects gives you some added insight when you examine trees.

additionalEntries.name: Repair
entries: As part of a short rest, you can repair a single damaged wooden object.

additionalEntries.name: Craft Arrows
entries: As part of a short rest, you can craft up to five arrows. As part of a long rest, you can craft up to twenty. You must have enough wood on hand to produce them.

additionalEntries.caption: Woodcarver's Tools
rows: Carve an intricate pattern in wood

items.name: Ability:
entries: 敏捷

items.name: Utilize:
entries: 在木頭上雕刻花紋（{@dc 10}）

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Club|XPHB|棍棒}、{@item Greatclub|XPHB|巨棍}、{@item Quarterstaff|XPHB|長棍}、遠程武器（{@item Pistol|XPHB|手槍}、{@item Musket|XPHB|鳥銃}與{@item Sling|XPHB|投石索}除外）、{@item Arcane Focus|XPHB|奧術法器}、{@item Arrows (20)|XPHB|箭}、{@item Bolts (20)|XPHB|弩矢}、{@item Druidic Focus|XPHB|德魯伊法器}、{@item Ink Pen|XPHB|墨水筆}、{@item Needles (50)|XPHB|吹針}

baseitem.name: Yarting
entries: A southern instrument from Amn and Calimshan that is a Faerûnian analog to the guitar. Numerous variations have spread across the continent.

baseitem.name: Yklwa
entries: A yklwa (pronounced YICK-ul-wah) is a simple melee weapon that is the traditional weapon of Chultan warriors. A yklwa consists of a 3-foot wooden shaft with a steel or stone blade up to 18 inches long. Although it has the thrown weapon property, the yklwa is not well balanced for throwing.

baseitem.name: Zulkoon
entries: A complex pump organ that originated with the zulkirs of Thay, who use it in the casting of their spells. It is considered to have a dramatic, but sinister, sound.

entries.name: Two-Handed
entries: This weapon requires two hands to use. This property is relevant only when you attack with the weapon, not when you simply hold it.

entries.name: Two-Handed
entries: 雙手武器在你用它攻擊時需要用兩隻手持握。

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack. Loading a one-handed weapon requires a free hand. At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon. A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: 只有在你擁有可供發射的彈藥時，才能使用具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊。所需的彈藥類型標示於武器的射程旁。每次攻擊消耗一件彈藥。取出彈藥是攻擊的一部分（裝填單手武器時你需要一隻空手）。戰鬥結束後，你可以花費 1 分鐘回收戰鬥中所用彈藥的一半（向下取整），其餘的則會遺失。

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack. Loading a one-handed weapon requires a free hand. The ammunition of a firearm is destroyed upon use.
If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon. A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: Firearm Bullets are destroyed upon use in a modern firearm. Futuristic firearms use Energy Cells that become depleted but could possibly be recharged with the proper equipment, at the GM's discretion.

entries.name: Burst Fire
entries: A weapon that has the burst fire property can make a single-target attack, or it can spray a 10-foot-cube area within normal range with shots. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take the weapon's normal damage. This action uses ten pieces of ammunition.

entries.name: Burst Fire
entries: As an action, you can expend 10 pieces of a Burst Fire weapon's ammunition to spray shots in a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within the weapon's normal range. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take damage. Roll the weapon's damage once, and apply it to each creature that failed the save.

entries.name: Finesse
entries: When making an attack with a finesse weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entries.name: Finesse
entries: 以靈巧武器進行攻擊時，你可以選擇使用力量或敏捷調整值進行攻擊擲骰與傷害擲骰。兩次擲骰必須使用相同的調整值。

entries.name: Heavy
entries: Creatures that are Small or Tiny have disadvantage on attack rolls with heavy weapons. A heavy weapon's size and bulk make it too large for a Small or Tiny creature to use effectively.

entries.name: Heavy
entries: 若重型武器是近戰武器而你的力量值低於 13，或它是遠程武器而你的敏捷值低於 13，你以該武器進行的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

entries.name: Light
entries: A light weapon is small and easy to handle, making it ideal for use when fighting with two weapons.

entries.name: Light
entries: 當你在自己的回合執行{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作並以輕型武器攻擊時，你可以在同一回合稍後作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}進行一次額外攻擊。該額外攻擊必須使用另一把輕型武器，且除非屬性調整值為負，否則你不將屬性調整值加到額外攻擊的傷害上。例如，你可以一手持{@item Shortsword|XPHB|短劍}、另一手持{@item Dagger|XPHB|匕首}，分別以{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作和{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}進行攻擊，但除非力量或敏捷調整值為負，否則你不將其加到{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}攻擊的傷害擲骰上。

entries.name: Loading
entries: Because of the time required to load this weapon, you can fire only one piece of ammunition from it when you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

entries.name: Loading
entries: 當你使用一個動作、{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}或{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}發射裝填武器時，無論你通常能進行幾次攻擊，都只能從中發射一件彈藥。

entries.name: Reach
entries: This weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it. This property also determines your reach for opportunity attacks with a reach weapon.

entries.name: Reach
entries: 觸及武器在你用它攻擊時，以及用它決定{@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|借機攻擊}的觸及範圍時，使你的觸及範圍增加 5 呎。

entries.name: Reload
entries: A limited number of shots can be made with a weapon that has the reload property. A character must then reload it using an action or a bonus action (the character's choice).

entries.name: Reload
entries: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Thrown
entries: If a weapon has the thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack. If the weapon is a melee weapon, you use the same ability modifier for that attack roll and damage roll that you would use for a melee attack with the weapon. For example, if you throw a handaxe, you use your Strength, but if you throw a dagger, you can use either your Strength or your Dexterity, since the dagger has the finesse property.

entries.name: Thrown
entries: 若武器具有投擲屬性，你可以投擲該武器進行遠程攻擊，並可以在攻擊中拔出該武器。若該武器是近戰武器，攻擊擲骰與傷害擲骰使用與你以該武器進行近戰攻擊時相同的屬性調整值。

entries.name: Versatile
entries: This weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property—the damage when the weapon is used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Versatile
entries: 多用武器可以單手或雙手使用。此屬性旁會附上一個括號內的傷害值，這是以雙手使用該武器進行近戰攻擊時造成的傷害。

entries.name: Vestige of Divergence
entries: {@note This item is a Vestige of Divergence, see {@book Vestiges of Divergence|EGW|7|Vestiges of Divergence} for more information.}

itemType.name: Treasure (Art Object)
entries: Idols cast of solid gold, necklaces studded with precious stones, paintings of ancient kings, bejeweled dishes—art objects include all these and more.

itemType.name: Treasure (Coinage)
entries: 角色在冒險中經常會找到錢幣，並能在商店、旅店和其他商家使用。錢幣依其材質的相對價值分為不同面額。「錢幣價值」表列出各種錢幣及其相對於金幣的價值，金幣是遊戲中的主要貨幣。例如，100 枚銅幣價值 1 枚金幣。
一枚錢幣重約三分之一盎司，因此五十枚錢幣重一磅。

itemType.name: Treasure (Gemstone)
entries: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.

itemType.name: Artisan's Tools
entries: These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade. Proficiency with a set of artisan's tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make using the tools in your craft. Each type of artisan's tools requires a separate proficiency.

itemType.name: Artisan's Tools
entries: 每種工匠工具都專注於製作物品與從事某種行業。每種工匠工具需要各自的熟練。
若你熟練某項工具，在使用該工具進行的任何屬性檢定上，你可以加上你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}。若你也熟練該檢定所用的技能，你在該檢定上還具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

itemType.name: Gaming Set
entries: If you are proficient with a gaming set, you can add your proficiency bonus to ability checks you make to play a game with that set. Each type of gaming set requires a separate proficiency.

itemType.name: Gaming Set
entries: 若你熟練某項工具，在使用該工具進行的任何屬性檢定上，你可以加上你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}。若你也熟練該檢定所用的技能，你在該檢定上還具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

itemType.name: Instrument
entries: If you have proficiency with a given musical instrument, you can add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to play music with the instrument. A bard can use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus. Each type of musical instrument requires a separate proficiency.

itemType.name: Instrument
entries: 若你熟練某項工具，在使用該工具進行的任何屬性檢定上，你可以加上你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}。若你也熟練該檢定所用的技能，你在該檢定上還具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Range
entries: A weapon that can be used to make a ranged attack has a range shown in parentheses after the ammunition or thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second indicates the weapon's maximum range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the weapon's long range.

entries.name: Range
entries: 遠程武器的射程標示在彈藥或投擲屬性後的括號中，列出兩個數字：第一個是武器的一般射程（以呎為單位），第二個是武器的長射程。攻擊一般射程外的目標時，你的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。你無法攻擊長射程外的目標。

entries.name: Crew
entries: A ship needs a crew of skilled hirelings to function. As per the Player's Handbook, one skilled hireling costs at least 2 gp per day. The minimum number of skilled hirelings needed to crew a ship depends on the type of vessel.

You can track the loyalty of individual crew members or the crew as a whole using the optional loyalty rules in chapter 4 of the Dungeon Master's Guide. If at least half the crew becomes disloyal during a voyage, the crew turns hostile and stages a mutiny. If the ship is berthed, disloyal crew members leave the ship and never return.

entries.name: Passengers
entries: This indicates the number of Small and Medium passengers the ship can accommodate.
Accommodations consist of shared hammocks in tight quarters. A ship outfitted with private accommodations can carry one-fifth as many passengers.
A passenger is usually expected to pay 5 sp per day for a hammock, but prices can vary from ship to ship. A small private cabin usually costs 2 gp per day.

entries.name: Cargo
entries: The maximum tonnage the ship can carry.

entries.name: Damage Threshold
entries: If a ship has a Damage Threshold, it has immunity to all damage unless it takes an amount of damage equal to or greater than its damage threshold, in which case it takes damage as normal. Any damage that fails to meet or exceed the damage threshold is considered superficial and doesn't reduce the ship's hit points.

entries.name: Ship Repair
entries: Repairs to a damaged ship can be made while the vessel is berthed. Repairing 1 hit point of damage requires 1 day and costs 20 gp for materials and labor.

entries.name: Speed
entries: 逆著強風航行的船隻只能以半速移動。在完全無風時，水上船隻無法揚帆航行，必須划槳。龍骨船與划艇用於湖泊和河流。若順流而下，將水流速度（通常為每小時 3 哩）加到載具的速度上。這些載具無法逆著任何明顯的水流划行，但可以由岸上的役畜拉往上游。划艇可以被搬運，重 100 磅。

entries.name: Crew
entries: 比龍骨船或划艇更大的船隻需要一組熟練的受僱者（見「{@book 服務|XPHB|6|Services}」）才能運作。操作一艘船所需的最少熟練受僱者人數取決於船隻類型。

entries.name: Passengers
entries: 船隻使用吊床所能容納的小型與中型乘客人數。配備私人艙房的船隻能搭載的乘客數為其五分之一。乘客使用吊床通常每天支付 5 SP，但價格因船而異。小型私人艙房通常每天 2 GP。

entries.name: Damage Threshold
entries: 見{@variantrule Damage Threshold|XPHB|規則詞彙表}。

entries.name: Ship Repair
entries: 受損的船隻可在停泊時進行修理。修復 1 點{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}的損傷需要 1 天，並花費 20 GP 的材料與人工費。若在物資和熟練工人充足的地點（例如城市造船廠）進行修理，修理時間與費用減半。

itemType.name: Tool
entries: 若你熟練某項工具，在使用該工具進行的任何屬性檢定上，你可以加上你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}。若你也熟練該檢定所用的技能，你在該檢定上還具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

itemType.name: Trade Bar
entries: Because large numbers of coins can be difficult to transport and account for, many merchants prefer to use trade bars—ingots of precious metals and alloys (usually silver). These bars are valued by weight.

itemType.name: Trade Good
entries: Most wealth is not in coins. It is measured in livestock, grain, land, rights to collect taxes, or rights to resources (such as a mine or a forest).

Guilds, nobles, and royalty regulate trade. Chartered companies are granted rights to conduct trade along certain routes, to send merchant ships to various ports, or to buy or sell specific goods. Guilds set prices for the goods or services that they control, and determine who may or may not offer those goods and services. Merchants commonly exchange trade goods without using currency.

itemType.name: Trade Good
entries: Merchants commonly exchange trade goods without using currency.

itemTypeAdditionalEntries.name: Gaming Set
entries: Proficiency with a gaming set applies to one type of game, such as Three-Dragon Ante or games of chance that use dice.

entries.name: Components
entries: A gaming set has all the pieces needed to play a specific game or type of game, such as a complete deck of cards or a board and tokens.

entries.name: History
entries: Your mastery of a game includes knowledge of its history, as well as of important events it was connected to or prominent historical figures involved with it.

entries.name: Insight
entries: Playing games with someone is a good way to gain understanding of their personality, granting you a better ability to discern their lies from their truths and read their mood.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries: Sleight of Hand is a useful skill for cheating at a game, as it allows you to swap pieces, palm cards, or alter a die roll. Alternatively, engrossing a target in a game by manipulating the components with dexterous movements is a great distraction for a pickpocketing attempt.

entries.caption: Gaming Set
rows: Gain insight into an opponent's personality

itemTypeAdditionalEntries.name: Instrument
entries: Proficiency with a musical instrument indicates you are familiar with the techniques used to play it. You also have knowledge of some songs commonly performed with that instrument.

entries.name: History
entries: Your expertise aids you in recalling lore related to your instrument.

entries.name: Performance
entries: Your ability to put on a good show is improved when you incorporate an instrument into your act.

entries.name: Compose a Tune
entries: As part of a long rest, you can compose a new tune and lyrics for your instrument. You might use this ability to impress a noble or spread scandalous rumors with a catchy tune.

itemEntry.name: Absorbing Tattoo
entriesTemplate: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo features designs that emphasize one color ({{item.detail1}}).

entriesTemplate.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.

entriesTemplate.name: Damage Resistance
entries: While the tattoo is on your skin, you have resistance to {{item.resist}} damage.

entriesTemplate.name: Damage Absorption
entries: When you take {{item.resist}} damage, you can use your reaction to gain immunity against that instance of the damage, and you regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage you would have taken. Once this reaction is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

itemEntry.name: Armor of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have resistance to {{item.resist}} damage while you wear this armor.

itemEntry.name: Armor of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage while you wear this armor.

itemEntry.name: Chromatic Rose
entriesTemplate: While this rose is held, it {{item.detail1}} as a harmless visual effect.

While holding the rose by its stem, you gain resistance to {{item.resist}} damage. If you would take more than 10 {{item.resist}} damage from a single source (after applying the resistance), the rose disintegrates, and you take no damage instead.

As an action, you can blow the petals from the rose to produce a 20-foot cone of {{item.resist}}. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} {{item.resist}} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Using this property destroys the rose.

itemEntry.name: Dragon Scale Mail
entriesTemplate: Dragon Scale Mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them. Other times, hunters carefully preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, Dragon Scale Mail is highly valued.

While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to discern the distance and direction to the closest {{item.detail1}} dragon within 30 miles of yourself. This action can't be used again until the next dawn.

itemEntry.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, a character can throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away. With a grenade launcher, the character can propel the grenade up to 120 feet away.

itemEntry.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, you can either throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away or use a Grenade Launcher to propel the grenade to a point up to 1,000 feet away. The grenade explodes at that point, creating a particular effect in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

itemEntry.name: Ioun Stone
entriesTemplate: Roughly marble sized, {@i Ioun Stones} are named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun Stones} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to toss an {@i Ioun Stone} into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three {@i Ioun Stones} orbiting your head at the same time.

Each {@i Ioun Stone} orbiting your head is considered to be an object you are wearing. The orbiting stone avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to avoid collisions and thwarting all attempts by other creatures to attack or snatch it.

As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can seize and stow any number of {@i Ioun Stones} orbiting your head. If your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to an Ioun Stone ends while it's orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

itemEntry.name: Potion of Resistance
entriesTemplate: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to {{item.resist}} damage for 1 hour.

itemEntry.name: Potion of Resistance
entriesTemplate: When you drink this potion, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage for 1 hour.

itemEntry.name: Ring of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have resistance to {{item.resist}} damage while wearing this ring. The ring is set with {{item.detail1}}.

itemEntry.name: Ring of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage while wearing this ring. The ring is set with {{item.detail1}}.

itemEntry.name: Scroll of Protection
entriesTemplate: Using a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to read the scroll creates a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. For 5 minutes, {{item.detail2}} can't enter or affect anything in the area. However, if you move in such a way that an {{item.detail1}} would be inside the area, the effect ends.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, a creature within 5 feet of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} can attempt to overcome it, which forces the creature to make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature ceases to be affected by the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

itemMastery.name: Cleave
entries: 若你以此武器的近戰攻擊檢定命中一個生物，你可以對第一個生物 5 呎內、且同樣位於你觸及範圍內的第二個生物，以該武器進行一次近戰攻擊檢定。命中時，第二個生物受到該武器的傷害，但除非屬性調整值為負，否則你不將其加到該傷害上。你每回合只能進行一次此額外攻擊。

itemMastery.name: Graze
entries: 若你以此武器進行的攻擊檢定未命中一個生物，你可以對該生物造成等同於你進行攻擊檢定所用屬性調整值的傷害。此傷害的類型與武器造成的傷害類型相同，且只能透過提升該屬性調整值來增加。

itemMastery.name: Nick
entries: 當你進行輕型屬性的額外攻擊時，你可以將其作為{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作的一部分進行，而非作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}。你每回合只能進行一次此額外攻擊。

itemMastery.name: Push
entries: 若你以此武器命中一個大型或更小的生物，你可以將該生物朝遠離你的方向直線推開至多 10 呎。

itemMastery.name: Sap
entries: 若你以此武器命中一個生物，該生物在你的下個回合開始前所進行的下一次攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

itemMastery.name: Slow
entries: 若你以此武器命中一個生物並對其造成傷害，你可以使其{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}降低 10 呎，直到你的下個回合開始。若該生物被具有此屬性的武器命中不止一次，{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}的降低量不會超過 10 呎。

itemMastery.name: Topple
entries: 若你以此武器命中一個生物，你可以迫使該生物進行一次體質豁免檢定（{@dc 8} + 你進行攻擊檢定所用的屬性調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}）。豁免失敗時，該生物處於{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態。

itemMastery.name: Vex
entries: 若你以此武器命中一個生物並對其造成傷害，你在你的下個回合結束前對該生物進行的下一次攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。
